digest.component_or_area: llm-workflow config cutover — AST gate seam enforcement
propositions: 23 below-seam ambient config reads in LLM subsystem are flagged as LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS by check_config_ownership.py AST gate; 19 must be routed through owned config.py/_config_sources.py resolvers (live-per-call) and 4 must be marked with per-line # read-via: comments (capped at 4 allowed exceptions).
All 23 LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS rows must be removed from config_ownership_exceptions.py after reads are remediated; check_config_ownership.py must report zero findings for the 21 listed file paths.

Owned resolvers must be added for run-scoped root, gate ref/source, plan review budget, usage log sink, and preview timeout — each preserving exact precedence, clamping, and live-per-call re-read behavior matching the original implementation.

The 4 owned-in-place reads (gate_context.py L201, gate_ops.py L196, executor.py L442, interpreter.py L206) must be the only reads carrying # read-via: markers; all other reads must be cut to seams or removed.
Behavioral regression suites (plan_review, workflow, consumer suites, lifecycle suites) must pass green; operation-snapshot fingerprints must remain unchanged except for recorded deltas.
Mid-operation environment variable overrides for cut config reads must still be observed after the cutover (live-per-call timing regression test required).
